title: pvTIFFSeriesReader
body:
## pvTIFFSeriesReader

Reads TIFF images (.tif, .tiff; 8- or 16-bit integer or 32-bit float) into uniform image data. Several files are stacked as z slices by default (ReadAsImageStack true) or read as a time series. Spacing comes from the TIFF resolution tags (millimetres for inch or centimetre units, otherwise 1) unless UseCustomDataSpacing applies CustomDataSpacing. Pair with pvWriteTIFFWriter for round trips; use pvOMETIFFReader for OME-TIFF.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Resolution tags written for printing (e.g. 72 dpi) give spacings near 0.35 mm; set a custom spacing when the image represents physical data.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TIFFSeriesReader`. Identity: `sources/TIFFSeriesReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CustomDataSpacing` | Set the spacing to use for the image output by this reader. This is used only when **UseCustomDataSpacing** is set to true. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `FileNames` | The list of files to be read by the reader. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ReadAsImageStack` | When set, the reader will read the set of files as an image stack, rather than a temporal file series. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseCustomDataSpacing` | To manually specify a custom spacing using **CustomDataSpacing**, set this property to 1 (checked). | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvTIFFSeriesReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
